variants.title: 白＋青蓝
variants.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Input image 1 is the APPROVED visual design reference, a white armored contemporary FPV quadcopter. Redraw it as a beautiful TRUE ORTHOGRAPHIC SIDE ELEVATION for a 2.5D side-scrolling action game. This is a side-view redesign based closely on the reference, not a three-quarter view, NOT a render of a black battery block. ONE drone only in a landscape 3:2 image, nose points RIGHT, antenna at LEFT rear. Camera exactly perpendicular to longitudinal body axis, eye-level, ZERO perspective, ZERO yaw, ZERO pitch, do NOT expose the front camera lens face or a large top plane. Four real open propellers on four motor arms in an X quadcopter arrangement; in this true side projection the far pair naturally overlaps the near pair, do not line up four motors lengthwise just to make all four visible. Long sleek white body shell with a purposeful gently sloping nose, lower chin camera bracket, sculpted angular side panels with subtly rounded bevels, integrated dark cooling vent recesses, thin raised top spine and shorter angled rear antenna. Cover battery with cohesive WHITE upper/lower side armor, NO black battery retaining straps across the body, no huge rectangular exposed battery. Keep compact modern FPV proportions and the reference design language. White occupies 75-85% of fuselage area; carbon-black spars/undercarriage and graphite seams only for structure. Accent color occupies only 10-15% of fuselage, never recolor the whole fuselage. Clear elegant silhouette at small game scale, moderate mechanical details. Small side mounting tabs below body, no hanging payload necessary. Preserve believable open rotors, no ducts, no flying saucer, no airplane wings. Propeller blade variation should remain physically consistent even if subtle in side elevation. Polished premium industrial game concept illustration, clean PBR-like materials, soft diffuse light showing WHITE material detail without overexposure, light neutral warm-gray plain studio background, faint grounding shadow. Fully frame rotor tips and antenna with generous margins. No text, no logos, no labels, no watermark, no panels or collage. Color variant: electric cyan inset lights, muted cyan side-panel insert and dark graphite two-blade propellers with cyan tips
